arc_format.description: The arc story format this story is written against. A bare integer: a story either conforms to a format or it does not. Optional so that stories predating it still validate, and warned about rather than rejected — but every story arc creates declares one, and a consumer that meets a higher number than it knows must stop rather than guess. See STORY-FORMAT.md.
